orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sharad Kumar Sharma
orders.text:
CRLR No. 424 of 2018 
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Lokendra Dobhal, Advocate for the 
revisionist. 
Mr. A.K. Shah, Brief Holder for the State 
of Uttarakhand. 
The defect which has been pointed out by 
the Registry is that the revisionist has not 
impleaded the State Government as a party. 
Learned counsel for the revisionist makes 
an oral prayer and is permitted to implead State 
as respondent no. 2 in the present Writ Petition 
during the course of the day. 
Admit. 
Issue notices to the respondents. 
Steps may be taken within a week. 
Learned counsel for the revisionist 
submits that this is a family dispute between 
husband and wife and there is a possibility that 
the same could be amicably settled. 
Hence, put up this matter on 10.01.2019 
to enable the parties to appear in person so that 
they can make an effort for mediation. 
 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 
 14.12.2018 
Pooja

orders.text:
CRLR NO. 424 of 2018 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Lokendra Dobhal, Advocate for 
the revisionist. 
 Mr. Sadeep Tandon, Dy. A.G. with Ms. 
Shivangi Gangwar, Brief Holder for the 
State. 
 Mr. Aditya Singh, Advocate for private 
respondents. 
 The matter pertains to matrimonial 
discord between the parties. 
 Learned counsel for the parties 
submitted that there are chances of 
amicable settlement between the parties. 
 List this matter on 07.05.2019. 
 Parties shall remain present for 
mediation on the date fixed. 
 Petitioner no.1-Mohamad Shakeel 
Ansari shall pay an amount of Rs.5,000/- 
to respondent no.1-Smt. Rizwana Parveen 
towards traveling expenses on the date 
fixed. 
 
(Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
 09.04.2019
Mamta
